entry.author: Interislander
entry.summary:
Interislander has been connecting New Zealand across Cook Strait for over 60 years.

🔍 Find us on https://instagram.com/interislander_nz & https://facebook.com/Interislander

⛴️ Book now on https://interislander.co.nz

We are the original Cook Strait Ferry. We sail between the North and South Islands (Wellington and Picton) every day, carrying passengers and freight. Along with the breathtaking views, enjoy our locally sourced cuisine, cinemas, free kids activities and premium lounges.
